title: Climate change, catastrophes, insurance and the macroeconomy
abstract: This paper examines the role of insurance in mitigating the adverse macroeconomic effects of climate-related catastrophes. We first develop a stylised theoretical growth model which incorporates a role for natural catastrophes, climate change and insurance. This illustrates how insurance can mitigate the impact of catastrophes and articulates the potential effect of falling insurance coverage as global warming intensifies. The model also provides a basis for our empirical analysis which explores the link between insurance coverage and the macroeconomic impact of catastrophes for a sample of several thousand disaster events across 47 developed and middle income countries between 1996 and 2019. The results confirm that higher insurance coverage is associated with less severe macroeconomic consequences of disasters. With climate-related catastrophes becoming ever more frequent and severe, our findings highlight the importance of developing policies to reduce the climate insurance protection gap.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了保险在减轻气候相关灾害对宏观经济的不利影响方面的作用。我们首先构建了一个简化的理论增长模型，其中纳入了自然灾害、气候变化和保险的作用。该模型说明了保险如何减轻灾害的影响，并阐明了随着全球变暖加剧，保险覆盖率下降可能产生的潜在效应。该模型也为我们的实证分析提供了基础，实证分析利用1996至2019年间47个发达国家和中等收入国家的数千起灾害事件样本，考察保险覆盖率与灾害宏观经济影响之间的关系。结果证实，保险覆盖率越高，灾害的宏观经济后果越轻。随着气候相关灾害日益频繁和严重，我们的发现凸显了制定政策以缩小气候保险保护缺口的重要性。

title: Macroprudential Policy, Monetary Policy and Non-Bank Financial Intermediation
Climate change, bank liquidity and systemic risk
abstract: This paper examines the relevance of banks’ exposure to climate transition risk in the interbank lending market. Using transaction-level data on repo agreements, we first establish that banks with higher exposure to transition risk face significantly higher borrowing costs. This premium is a combination of a risk premium, compensating lenders for increased credit risk, and an inconvenience premium, reflecting the sustainability preferences of key dealer banks. We also find that the transition risk premium intensifies during periods of financial stress, indicating that climate-induced risks amplify existing vulnerabilities in financial markets. Furthermore, the rate segmentation caused by transition risk premium has implications for the transmission of monetary policy. Transition risk is an important factor in financial stability and policy design.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了银行在同业拆借市场中所面临的气候转型风险敞口的相关性。利用回购协议的交易层面数据，我们首先确认，转型风险敞口较高的银行面临显著更高的借款成本。这一溢价是两部分的组合：一部分是风险溢价，补偿出借方增加的信用风险；另一部分是不便溢价（inconvenience premium），反映了主要交易商银行的可持续性偏好。我们还发现，转型风险溢价在金融压力时期会加剧，表明气候引发的风险会放大金融市场中的既有脆弱性。此外，转型风险溢价所造成的利率分割，对货币政策的传导具有影响。转型风险是金融稳定和政策设计中的一个重要因素。

title: Sustainability labels vs. reality: how climate-friendly are green and ESG funds?
abstract: This paper assesses the environmental performance of sustainability-related investment funds compared to conventional ones across three dimensions: financed activities, portfolio carbon footprint, and investment in firms with ambitious science-based targets. We identify ESG funds using Morningstar (MS) strategies, the Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation’s Article 8/9 classification, and funds’ self-naming. We find that the greenest funds invest more in low-carbon sectors, but their carbon footprints are comparable to conventional funds. Also, MS Low-Carbon and Art.8 funds tend to invest in the same sectors as conventional funds but target less polluting firms. Overall, results reveal inconsistencies between ESG labels and outcomes, highlighting the limited role these funds currently play in financing the transition to a net-zero economy.
abstract_zh: 本文从三个维度评估了与传统基金相比，可持续相关投资基金的环境表现：所融资的活动、投资组合碳足迹，以及对设定了雄心勃勃科学碳目标（science-based targets）企业的投资。我们利用晨星（Morningstar，MS）策略、《可持续金融披露条例》（SFDR）第8条/第9条分类以及基金自身的命名，识别ESG基金。我们发现，最绿色的基金更多地投资于低碳行业，但其碳足迹与传统基金相当。此外，晨星低碳基金和第8条基金倾向于投资与传统基金相同的行业，但其目标企业的污染程度较低。总体而言，结果揭示了ESG标签与实际结果之间的不一致，凸显了这些基金在为向净零经济转型提供融资方面目前所发挥的有限作用。

title: When margins call: liquidity preparedness of non-bank financial institutions
Financing the low-carbon transition in Europe
abstract: Using evidence from the EU emissions trading system, we collect verified emissions of close to 4000 highly polluting and mostly non-listed firms responsible for 26% of EU’s emissions. Over the period 2013- 2019, we find a non-linear relationship between leverage and emissions. A firm with higher leverage has lower emissions in subsequent years. However, when leverage exceeds 50%, a further increase is associated with higher emissions. Our difference-in-differences approach sheds light on the existence of a group of firms that are too indebted to successfully accomplish the low-carbon transition, even when they face a steep increase in the cost of their emissions.
abstract_zh: 利用欧盟排放交易体系的证据，我们收集了近4000家高污染、且大多未上市的企业的经核查排放数据，这些企业的排放量占欧盟排放总量的26%。在2013至2019年期间，我们发现杠杆率与排放之间存在非线性关系。杠杆率较高的企业在随后几年的排放较低。然而，当杠杆率超过50%时，杠杆率的进一步上升则与排放增加相关。我们的双重差分方法揭示了这样一组企业的存在：即使面临排放成本的急剧上升，它们的债务负担也过于沉重，无法成功实现低碳转型。

title: Are ethical and green investment funds more resilient?
abstract: Funds with an environmental, social and corporate governance (ESG) mandate have been growing rapidly in recent years and received inﬂows also during periods of market turmoil, such as March 2020, in contrast to their non-ESG peers. This paper investigates whether investors in ESG funds react diﬀerently to past negative performance, making these funds less sensitive to short-term changes in returns. In the absence of an ESG-label, we deﬁne an ESG- or Environmentally-focused fund if its name contains relevant words. The results show that ESG/E equity and corporate bond funds exhibit a weaker ﬂow-performance relationship compared to traditional funds in 2016-2020. This ﬁnding may reﬂect the longer-term investment horizon of ESG investors and their expectation of better risk-adjusted performance from ESG funds in the future. We also explore how the results vary across institutional and retail investors and how they depend on the liquidity of funds’ assets and wider market conditions. A weaker ﬂow-performance relationship allows funds to provide a stable source of ﬁnancing to the green transition and may reduce risks for ﬁnancial stability, particularly during turmoil episodes.
abstract_zh: 具有环境、社会和公司治理（ESG）任务的基金近年来迅速增长，即使在市场动荡时期（如2020年3月），这类基金也持续获得资金流入，与其非ESG同类基金形成对比。本文考察了ESG基金的投资者对过去负面业绩的反应是否不同，从而使这些基金对收益的短期变化不那么敏感。在没有ESG标签的情况下，若基金名称包含相关词汇，我们便将其定义为ESG或环境导向型基金。结果表明，在2016至2020年间，ESG/E股票基金和企业债基金的资金流量与业绩之间的关系弱于传统基金。这一发现可能反映了ESG投资者较长的投资期限，以及他们对ESG基金未来能获得更好风险调整后收益的预期。我们还探讨了结果在机构投资者与散户投资者之间如何变化，以及其如何取决于基金资产的流动性和更广泛的市场环境。较弱的资金流量—业绩关系使基金能够为绿色转型提供稳定的资金来源，并可能降低金融稳定风险，尤其是在动荡时期。

title: Investment funds, risk-taking, and monetary policy in the euro area
The low-carbon transition, climate commitments and firm credit risk
abstract: This paper explores how the need to transition to a low-carbon economy influences firm credit risk. It develops a novel dataset which augments data on firms’ green-house gas emissions over time with information on climate disclosure practices and forward-looking emission reduction targets, thereby providing a rich picture of firms’ climate-related transition risk alongside their strategies to manage such risks. It then assesses how such climate-related metrics influence two key measures of firms’ credit risk: credit ratings and the market-implied distance-to-default. High emissions tend to be associated with higher credit risk. But disclosing emissions and setting a forward-looking target to cut emissions are both associated with lower credit risk, with the effect of climate commitments tending to be stronger for more ambitious targets. After the Paris agreement, firms most exposed to climate transition risk also saw their ratings deteriorate whereas other comparable firms did not, with the effect larger for European than US firms, probably reflecting differential expectations around climate policy. These results have policy implications for corporate disclosures and strategies around climate change and the treatment of the climate-related transition risk faced by the financial sector.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了向低碳经济转型的需要如何影响企业的信用风险。我们构建了一个新颖的数据集，将企业随时间变化的温室气体排放数据，与气候信息披露实践以及具有前瞻性的减排目标信息相结合，从而全面刻画了企业的气候转型风险及其管理这些风险的战略。随后，我们评估了这些气候相关指标如何影响企业信用风险的两项关键度量：信用评级和市场隐含的违约距离（distance-to-default）。高排放往往与较高的信用风险相关。但披露排放以及设定具有前瞻性的减排目标，都与较低的信用风险相关，且气候承诺的效应在目标越具雄心时往往越强。《巴黎协定》签署之后，最易受气候转型风险影响的企业，其评级出现了恶化，而其他可比企业则没有，且这一效应在欧洲企业中大于美国企业，这可能反映了对气候政策的不同预期。这些结果对企业气候信息披露和应对气候变化的战略，以及金融部门对气候相关转型风险的处理具有政策含义。
